criteria.text: User Action: User navigates to their chore preferences. Expected System Behavior: Displays the household’s chores, each with an option to mark it as preferred.
criteria.note: Team decision (2026-11-19): the chores to prefer are Set chore preferences' chore types on the profile page (SCRUM-72), not each chore in the household. Add chore's optional Category links a chore to one.

criteria.text: User Action: User marks or unmarks chores as preferred and saves. Expected System Behavior: The preferences are saved, and a confirmation message is displayed.
User Action: A housemate assigns a chore. Expected System Behavior: Housemates who prefer that chore are shown as preferring it in the assignment options.
criteria.note: A chore's category is picked in Add chore; housemates who chose that type in Set chore preferences show “· Prefers this chore” in Assigned to.

criteria.text: Error Condition: The household has no chores yet. Expected message: “No chores to choose from yet.”
criteria.note: Can't happen since the team decision on AC1: the chore types are a fixed list, so there is always something to choose. Jira still says household chores.

criteria.text: Error Condition: The preferences fail to save. Expected message: The system displays an error message and provides an option to try saving again. Prototype: {Link}
criteria.note: Shows “Changes not saved. Please try again.” (SCRUM-72's wording); Save stays available to try again.
